attributes.action: Protect 10 years long residence route for migrants who arrived before May 2025
attributes.additional_details: Many migrants came to uk for education, not for settlement.Over time, they integrated into British society, build their lives and planned their futures around the existing 10 years long residence route.They invested years, made financial sacrifices and contributed to the UK. Removing this route without transitional protection would undermine their legitimate expectation and disrupt their futures.Those who arrived before the immigration white paper was published on 12 May 2025 deserve protection.
attributes.background: We ask the Uk government to retain the existing 10 years long residence route for migrants who entered the uk legally before 12 May 2025, including those on student and graduate visas, we request transitional arrangements to protect their eligibility for settlement under the existing route.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

Keep 10-year Long Residence Route for people already living in the UK
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/781255
